title: Larchmont Ferry booking outage report
brief: I'm the head of operations at Larchmont Ferry and I need the incident write-up for the online booking outage on Saturday 2026-10-03, for the executive team who will read it printed at Tuesday's review. Open with the impact as headline numbers: 98 minutes without online bookings, 1340 failed booking attempts, 61000 dollars of estimated lost sales, and 212 calls to the contact center in that hour, against a normal 40. Under "Timeline", with times that day: 08:12 the payment provider certificate expired and card payments began failing; 08:19 the booking success rate alert fired; 08:41 an incident was declared by Corinne Abara; 09:05 the cause was identified; 09:28 a new certificate was installed by Deepak Menon; 09:50 booking success returned to normal. Under "Cause": the certificate was not in the renewal inventory because it was bought under a former supplier contract in 2023 and lasted 3 years, and the expiry reminder went to a mailbox that nobody has used since 2025. Under "Follow-ups", a list with owner and date: add all certificates to one inventory with 30-day warnings, Deepak Menon, 2026-10-23; move reminders to the team channel, Corinne Abara, 2026-10-12; run a drill of the phone booking fallback, Yasmin Kerr, 2026-11-13. Call out that the fallback phone line was overloaded for 71 minutes of the outage.

edit.request: Correct the estimated lost sales to 57500 dollars, and move the certificate inventory follow-up to 2026-10-30.
